deliverable: Single-logical-launch attention_residual (RMSNorm along D -> pseudo-query score along D -> depth softmax along N -> weighted sum over ORIGINAL V -> alpha residual blend) executed on Ascend950PR, passing all 20 official cases through the original comparator.

official_cases.thresholds: ORIGINAL thresholds from proto.yaml precision_thresholds; NOT edited

implementation.shape: ONE T.Kernel launch. No second kernel, no GM intermediate score/probability array.
implementation.score_path: literal_fp32: k = v/rms*gamma, s = sum_d(k*w)/sqrt(D), matching the golden's arithmetic order
implementation.aggregation: reads the ORIGINAL v_ub, never the RMS-normalised key
implementation.persistent_residency: w and gamma are read once per AIV and reused across every token group

four_defects_found_by_running.symptom: compile error 'pointer arguments to simt_vf functions must reside in __gm__ or __ubuf__'
four_defects_found_by_running.cause: fragment buffers were live across separate SimtVF regions
four_defects_found_by_running.fix: all cross-region state moved to shared (UB); only per-region temporaries remain fragments

four_defects_found_by_running.symptom: with niter==1 every case exactly correct; with niter>1 EVERY iteration after the first wrong, deterministically at the same rows, only row 0 surviving
four_defects_found_by_running.cause: carrying m/l/acc across outer persistent-loop iterations is not correct in this emission
four_defects_found_by_running.fix: outer persistent loop removed: grid = M, one token group per program. Correctness is claimed ONLY for the configuration that was measured. The persistent g+=P schedule the spec describes is NOT claimed as met and remains open for G51.

four_defects_found_by_running.symptom: D=2047 and D=1000 fail 'no available layout found'
four_defects_found_by_running.cause: layout inference refuses a shared buffer whose extent is not a power of two
four_defects_found_by_running.fix: UB padded to next_power_of_2(D); every producer writes only i<D and every reduction masks i<D

four_defects_found_by_running.cause: copies moved D elements into a PD-element buffer
four_defects_found_by_running.fix: region copies touch exactly D elements of the padded buffer (the verified RMSNorm example's own pattern)

cases: M=1 decode at D=512 and D=4096
